release_notes:
Stop HTMLPurifier from truncating custom-field values (GSX reports etc.)

Customer/reseller order placement ran custom-field VALUES through
$purifier->purify(). HTMLPurifier is an HTML sanitizer: when a value
contains a '<' that looks like the start of a tag (common when pasting a
GSX 'Full info with Case History' report, a serial, or copied markup),
it treats the rest as an unclosed tag and DROPS everything after it —
silently truncating the field mid-content (e.g. order 101089 lost its
entire Case History section).

Replace purify() with check_input(strip_tags(...)) for custom-field
values in all placement paths (placeimeiorder, placeserverorder, order,
register, myprofile, api/placeorder CUSTOMFIELD, gsmfusion_api server
custom fields). strip_tags removes every tag (still XSS-safe against
<script> injection) but never drops trailing text. Matches the admin
side, which already uses check_input() without purify() for these fields.
